tools.name: resolve_date
tools.description: Turn one date/time phrase ("next Friday at 3pm", "in 2 weeks", "tomorrow 9am EST", "Dec 25 to Jan 2") into exact ISO 8601 UTC and local timestamps in an IANA zone, with precision, which parts were stated, DST gap/fold flags and ambiguity flags. found:false when no date is recognized. Use before acti

tools.name: extract_dates
tools.description: Find every date/time mention in a text (max 4 KB) and return each with its character index, matched text and resolved ISO timestamps (start and optional end of ranges).

tools.name: normalize_timestamps
tools.description: Convert up to 100 mixed timestamps (ISO 8601, RFC 2822, Unix seconds/ms/us/ns, slash dates, short date phrases) to UTC and local ISO 8601, flagging ambiguous day/month order.

tools.name: current_time
tools.description: Current date, time, weekday, UTC offset, ISO week and day of year in an IANA time zone. Useful because models do not know today's date.
